description:
Return curated information about Bad Kleinkirchheim and the house for a topic.

Use for "what can we do there?" and house questions: house rules and services (self-catering, no
breakfast, bread-roll service, no pets, baby cot/high chair on request, chip access), skiing (winter),
hiking, biking and lakes (summer), thermal spas and the in-house sauna (wellness), golf incl. the free
green fee and tee-time booking, families, workation, arrival. The Kärnten Card (summer only) and the free green fee are explained exactly. Not for
prices or availability (check_availability) and not for apartment facts (get_apartment_details).
Behaviour: read-only, static curated content from the property (no web search), instant.
Returns text plus structuredContent.topics (topic, lines) and contact details.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

topic.description: One of house (self-catering, bread rolls, pets, baby cot, chip access), winter, summer, wellness, golf, family, workation, arrival (aliases like 'ski', 'hund', 'breakfast', 'anreise' work); empty = overview
topic.title: Topic
